design: INDIVIDUAL 02: a short extremely broad elderly councillor with a heavy powerful torso and old ochre spotted hide, wide round rear cranium, dense short charcoal-grey tendrils tied in two low bundles. Layered sleeveless burgundy coat with broad ivory shoulder panels, a thick belt of five unequal bronze rank medallions. Both hands rest on top of a short blunt bronze walking staff planted beside the leading foot. Sturdy bowed-leg stance and large bare clawed feet.
